title: Sziget Festival: The Island of Freedom Becomes Global
grammar: Colloquial intensifiers and discourse particles (*tök, marha, irtó, csigavér, noha*)
goal: I can chronicle the rise of the Sziget Festival from 1993 Diáksziget to an internationally acclaimed cultural brand.
I can utilize colloquial intensifiers (tök jó, marha nehéz) and pragmatic particles without violating stylistic decorum.
I can debate the impact of mega-festivals on tourism, youth identity, and cultural diplomacy.
